synthesis:draft.headline: Tasmania five-minute RRP peaked at $450.08 at interval ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
summary: The five-minute Regional Reference Price (RRP) peak was $450.08 at interval end 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000).
Only one five-minute interval in the reviewed window reached or exceeded the $300.0/MWh analysis threshold (one interval ≥ $300/MWh).
The high-price episode reported covers 2026-08-06T02:55:00Z → 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z and the episode has n_intervals = 1.
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the peak five-minute interval (interval end 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 1105.32 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, 5-minute).

The half-hour operational demand for the half-hour containing the price extreme (interval end 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 1147.0 MW, and the window's maximum operational demand was 1408.0 MW (interval end 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z).
Net interchange at the peak five-minute interval (interval end 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 63.84 (net flow out of TAS1).

possible_explanations.statement: A short-duration local supply/demand imbalance around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z may explain the single-interval spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit dispatch changes and rebid logs covering the intervals around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z and high-resolution dispatch telemetry for the five-minute interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: A transient change in interconnector flows around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z might have contributed to the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine high-resolution net interchange and interconnector telemetry for intervals around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z and any associated re-dispatch records.

possible_explanations.statement: A rebid or short-notice withdrawal of generation capacity around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z could be involved.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review rebid logs and unit availability/contingency records for the intervals around 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z.
